title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.1
subtitle: Your viewport colors stay under your control.

highlights.title: Choose Your Shading
highlights.description: Random, Material, and other viewport color modes stay selected without resetting to Object.

highlights.title: Optional Role Colors
highlights.description: Enable role colors in Preferences when you need them. They are off by default and never restrict your shading choices.

improvements.text: Preferences explain how to display role colors using Solid shading and Object color mode.

fixes.text: Turning role colors off restores the original object colors, including when opening saved scenes.
